title: Define JWT identity and auth contract for cart/order endpoints
goal: Establish the authenticated identity contract and authorization expectations before implementing cart and order behavior.
repository_rationale: The user and shared token library own the JWT validation and principal extraction used by protected cart and order operations.

title: Implement authenticated cart retrieval and total calculation
goal: Add a cart view endpoint that returns current cart data, item-level product information, and a computed total for the authenticated user.
repository_rationale: Order service owns cart-item persistence and is the correct boundary for displaying cart state and totals to the current user.

title: Implement user-order history and authenticated order access
goal: Expose an authenticated order-history endpoint and enforce that users only see their own orders.
repository_rationale: Order service owns the order and order-item domain and should enforce user-scoped history and retrieval rules.

title: Complete order creation with stock validation, persistence, and cart clearing
goal: Finalize the purchase flow so it validates the user, cart, and stock, persists order items atomically, and removes only the purchased selections.
repository_rationale: The order service orchestrates the cart-to-order flow and is responsible for validation, stock checks, persistence, and cart cleanup after success.

title: Align product stock and downstream integration behavior for purchase flow
goal: Ensure product availability checks, stock updates, and error semantics support a consistent order-purchase flow.
repository_rationale: Product service owns product stock, product CRUD, and availability checks needed for order validation and reservation decisions.

title: Standardize validation, error handling, and authorization across services
goal: Add consistent validation, global exception mapping, and authorization enforcement across the microservice APIs.
repository_rationale: The shared validation library and the service exception layers define the common auth and validation patterns used by all protected APIs.

title: Document runtime dependencies and gateway routing contract
goal: Make gateway route behavior and required external config explicit and testable for local or demo deployments.
repository_rationale: The API gateway owns route discovery and request exposure from Consul metadata and therefore defines the user-facing contract for the demo flow.

title: Add purchase-flow and business-rule test coverage
goal: Verify the end-to-end purchase flow, empty-cart rejection, stock issues, and persistence semantics through tests.

verification.name: smoke flow
verification.command: cd product-service && mvn test -DskipTests=false && cd ../order-service && mvn test -DskipTests=false

repository_rationale: The order service is the best owner for the purchase flow, transaction, and cart logic tests exercising the end-to-end behavior.
